name: municipal_council_hall
source_description: A monumental secular municipal council hall for the centre of Elderboom: a broad, three-storey dark fieldstone civic building with a shallow U-shaped forecourt, five massive ground-level public arches, two recessed oak doors, tall rhythmically spaced upper windows, robust corner buttresses, a restrained central stone balcony, a high charcoal slate roof and paired chimney stacks. It must read immediately as the village seat of government, distinctly larger than every house but clearly not a church: no tower, no clock, no cross, no stained glass, no bell, no religious geometry. Damp soot-dark stone, moss only along the base, strong realistic silhouette.
